findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_booking_link, get_brief_status, get_upload_link, get_deposit_link · Private data: get_booking_link, send_brief, send_brand_guide, get_upload_link, book_call · Public sink: send_brief, send_brand_guide, get_brief_status, get_upload_link, get_deposit_link · Destructive: draft_a_script.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_booking_link, get_brief_status, get_upload_link, get_deposit_link · Private data: get_booking_link, send_brief, send_brand_guide, get_upload_link, book_call · Public sink: send_brief, send_brand_guide, get_brief_status, get_upload_link, get_deposit_link · Destructive: draft_a_script

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
